description: Execute a SPARQL SELECT query against the Wikidata Query Service. Full graph power: multi-hop traversals, aggregations, subqueries, OPTIONAL, FILTER, UNION, BIND. Standard Wikidata prefixes (wd:, wdt:, p:, ps:, pq:, wikibase:, bd:, rdfs:, schema:) are auto-injected. The wikibase:label SERVICE is also auto-injected when the query references a ?<var>Label, ?<var>Description, or ?<var>AltLabel variable and declares no label SERVICE of its own — so you can use ?itemLabel without writing the boilerplate. Scholarly articles, and every triple they own (DOI, PMID, authorship), live in a separate graph reachable only inside SERVICE wdsubgraph:scholarly_articles { … } (wdsubgraph: is predeclared). The injected label SERVICE runs on the main graph, so read a scholarly article's label inside that block, with BIND(?paperLabel AS ?paperLabel) and a label SERVICE there; a query that writes a label SERVICE gets none injected, so add a top-level one for main-graph labels. Hard server timeout is 60s; use LIMIT to keep queries fast. Each call returns at most 4,000 rows; a larger result returns its first rows with truncated, shown, and cap in place of totalCount — narrow the WHERE clause or aggregate in the query, or, for a result not much larger than that, page with ORDER BY plus LIMIT and OFFSET. Bindings use the SPARQL 1.1 JSON format: each value is { type, value, "xml:lang"?, datatype? }. Use wikidata_get_labels to humanize QID results from this tool.

language.description: Wikidata language code, or a comma-separated fallback list tried in order (e.g., "en", "de", "fr,en"), for the injected wikibase:label SERVICE — the language of ?<var>Label, ?<var>Description, and ?<var>AltLabel variables. The list falls back to the multilingual ("mul") label last unless it already names mul. Case-insensitive; "_" is read as "-"; blank means "en".

query.description: SPARQL SELECT query. Any other form — ASK, CONSTRUCT, DESCRIBE, an update, or plain search text — is rejected before it is sent. Standard prefixes (wd:, wdt:, p:, ps:, pq:, wikibase:, bd:, rdfs:, schema:) are injected automatically. Example: SELECT ?item ?itemLabel WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q146. } LIMIT 10

timeout.description: Client-side timeout in seconds (1–55). Capped at 55s — the Wikidata server hard limit is 60s.

name: wikidata_sparql_query

cap.description: The row ceiling that truncated the result.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_select_query`: The query is not a SELECT query: an ASK, CONSTRUCT, DESCRIBE, or update form, or plain text. `parse_error`: SPARQL syntax error — the query could not be parsed. `timeout`: The query ran past its client-side timeout, or past the Query Service's own 60s limit. `throttled`: The Wikidata SPARQL endpoint is rate-limiting this server: each client (user agent and IP) gets 60 seconds of query processing time per 60 seconds, and each IP at most 5 parallel queries. `result_too_large`: The result body is larger than the 8 MiB one call reads. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present when truncated (how to page or aggregate for the rest) or when no rows matched (where else to look).

results.description: Result bindings in query order: every row, or the first 4,000 when the result has more (truncated). Each row maps variable names to binding objects with { type, value, "xml:lang"?, datatype? } fields.

shown.description: Number of rows returned when truncated.

totalCount.description: Number of rows the query produced. Present only when the whole result was read: absent when truncated.

truncated.description: True when the result had more than 4,000 rows: only the first 4,000 were read and returned.

variables.description: Variable names returned by the SELECT clause.

title: Wikidata SPARQL Query
